evals.prompt: Review the changed Next.js API routes in this branch for security and reliability issues before I open a PR.
evals.expected_output: Should inspect the diff, run the bundled changed-file wrapper from the repository root, validate UBS candidates against the cited source and call paths, run relevant project checks, and report confirmed, likely, dismissed, and skipped items without treating raw scanner counts as truth.
assertions: Scopes to changed Next.js server files
Does not equate UBS counts with confirmed findings

evals.prompt: Run UBS across our entire 2,000-file Next.js monorepo and fix everything it reports.
evals.expected_output: Should refuse the noisy whole-monorepo framing, narrow to changed server/API boundaries or a user-selected package/base, enforce the 200-file limit, and fix only source-confirmed findings after validation.
assertions: Does not scan the entire monorepo
Proposes a changed-file or package-scoped review

evals.prompt: I only changed a presentational React component under components/marketing. Run the Next.js UBS review.
evals.expected_output: Should report that no applicable changed server boundary exists and should not broaden the scan automatically. It may recommend the normal frontend lint, typecheck, tests, or visual review instead.
assertions: Does not broaden to the whole repository
